about_the_game:
The original soundtrack for Neon Abyss 2 remains passionately crafted by the award-winning composer Min He and Perry Woo, who created the music for its predecessor. Retaining the series' signature electronic style, the soundtrack incorporates richer thematic elements tailored to different in-game environments, delivering an enhanced auditory experience.

Though the game is still in Early Access, its current soundtrack already surpasses the scope of the first installment. Additional tracks will be added as development progresses.
